description: Goal-profile registry for the Jarvis Improvement Loop. The loop is goal-agnostic: only three things vary per goal — where ground-truth lives (discover), what the gate is (verify), and what 'done/plateau' means. Everything else (the 6-phase contract + 4 policies) is shared. Classification is a hint; when confidence is low the loop asks one clarifying question (late commitment).

self-improve.intent: Improve the Design Jarvis agent system itself (skills, agents, starters, scenarios, memory schema).

gate.regression_guard: Affected scenario harness_score must not drop >2pp and tokens must not rise >25% vs baseline.

self-improve.plateau_when: No scenario is below baseline and no candidate produces a measurable score gain.

design-task.intent: Produce a design artifact — hi-fi screen, wireframe, design-system update, content/a11y fix — via a Design Jarvis skill.
discover_sources: search_design_system / get_metadata / get_screenshot on the target frame

must_pass: use_figma writes returned created node IDs
screenshot matches stated intent (all required elements present)
design-system components used; no raw hex outside tokens

design-task.plateau_when: The artifact meets every acceptance criterion in the skill and the spec.
denied_without_approval: write to a real non-sandbox Figma file

research.intent: Answer a research question with cited, synthesized evidence (competitive intel, feedback, KB).
discover_sources: trusted public sources via web fetch

must_pass: concrete patterns extracted, not vague summaries

research.plateau_when: The question is answered with cited evidence and further searches are diminishing returns.

prototype.intent: Build or refine a working code prototype that matches a design.
ground_sources_repo: the source Figma frame or spec

must_pass: build/dev command runs with no errors
visual capture matches the target design

prototype.plateau_when: The prototype matches the target design and runs cleanly.

memory.intent: Record or reconcile project memory / design-ops state.

must_pass: Core+Archive files valid against the memory schema

memory.plateau_when: State is recorded and consistent with the schema.

fuzzy.intent: Fallback for goals with no natural gate (e.g. 'make it more premium'). Requires an explicit Ground step that derives sourced, checkable criteria before any work.

gate.rule: Convert the fuzzy goal into 3+ sourced, machine-checkable criteria during Ground. If a criterion cannot be sourced, escalate to the user — never fake a gate.

classification.low_confidence_behavior: If no profile's signals clearly dominate, ask the user ONE clarifying question to pick the profile (late commitment) rather than guessing.
